_comment: C6-5 genmo bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（runway/luma/flux），related 写 3 条。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: In-house model line + open weights: Mochi 1, an open-source text-to-video model (GitHub genmoai/mochi, Apache-2.0, 3,757 stars, pushed 2026-10-22, GitHub API verified the same day); the in-product model-selection surface sits behind a login wall, not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Web (genmo.ai, /playground 200); product generation on the vendor's cloud. Open weights + training/inference code can run locally (provided in the repo) — self-running is a repo-level fact; the product itself ships no offline client.
axes.local_files: Product works stored account-side in the cloud; open weights and code go local (Apache-2.0). No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation is instant/queued (varies by tier, not verified item by item); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Text-to-video (the Mochi 1 line); the homepage headlines the "Open world models" narrative (direct-fetched the same day); product-side editing/interaction details not verified item by item (/docs and /api both 307 into a login wall).
axes.context: Organized via account works; cross-session memory — no official statement verified. Reusable open weights are asset reuse, not product memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (/pricing 200, D9: prices not collected); the training-use switch not verified line by line; training/commercial freedom of the open-weights repo follows Apache-2.0 itself.
axes.fit: Fits: creators and researchers who want open weights to self-run (Apache-2.0 is a rare permissive tier in this category), world-model narrative tracking, creative experiments. Does not fit: mainland compliance scenarios (not filed, not serving the mainland), enterprise SLA as the headline (no claim verified).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Mochi 1's real usability and output quality on consumer-grade VRAM**
- **The quality gap between open-weights output and product-side output**
- **The actual boundary between the "world model" narrative and today's interactive capability**
unknowns:
